# HAZWOPER for RCRA TSD & Hazardous Waste Technicians

> HAZWOPER for RCRA TSD & Hazardous Waste Technicians: 4 self-paced online courses from $89.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher - RCRA TSD Operations Training](https://hazwoper-tsd.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-138): $89.99 per person, 8 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months.
